title: Length after pivot extraction
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, choose a variable $v\in\nu$, and let a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ yield a pivot equation and a remaining list under pivot extraction at $v$. The length of the remaining list plus one equals the length of the original list.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ is a finite type with decidable equality
